title: Capacity Increase at IMH and Alexandra Hospital for Patients Seeking Mental Health Specialist Care
what_it_is: Capacity Increase at IMH and Alexandra Hospital for Patients Seeking Mental Health Specialist Care

sections.label: Mental health capacity expansion
sections.summary: IMH refurbished 11 acute psychiatric wards and the Government plans increases in psychiatrists, psychology trainees and community mental health services by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Institute of Mental Health (IMH) has recently refurbished 11 acute psychiatric wards to enhance inpatient care and will be expanding its capacity to meet future demand.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To support the increase in demand for mental health services, the Government is planning a 30% increase in the number of psychiatrists and 40% increase in the number of healthcare workers training in psychology by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Government will also expand mental health services in the primary and community settings to support the National Mental Health and Well-being Strategy.

sections.label: Clinical placements limit capacity
sections.summary: Clinical placements, not education institutions, limit capacity, and the Government will work with partners to realise plans for increased capacity.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: You need to have clinical placements rather than only lectures and seminars.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, the rate limiting factor for enhancing our capacity is the number of mentors and training places that we have within the clinical settings, rather than within the education institutions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We will work with all the partners and stakeholders to be able to realise our plans for an increase in capacity.
